shortDescription.title: Site Description
shortDescription.description:
Alphanumeric, 100000 characters - Overview of the key selling points of the item, marketing content, and highlights in paragraph form. For SEO purposes, repeat the product name and relevant keywords here. Example: The Greensaver Plus 18” x 8.50”-8 golf cart tire boasts a versatile design that allows it to be used on both grassy and paved surfaces. Its wide tread design allows for more even weight distribution, which helps to increase tread life and allows
it to tread lightly over sensitive areas like lawns and golf course greens without tearing them up. This painted white 4-ply tire has a fitment that is compatible with most OE applications and golf cart types. It can also hold a maximum load of 815 lbs, making it an excellent option for use with yard trailer attachments. The Greensaver street tire and wheel 4 lugs are reinforced with a strong sidewall so you enjoy a smooth ride, regardless.

count.title: Total Count
count.description: Number, Value range: 0 to 99999999999999 - The total number of identical items in the package or box; a result of the multiplication of Multipack Quantity by Count Per Pack. Examples: (1) A single bottle of 50 pills has a "Total Count" of 50. (2) A package containing two identical bottles of 50 pills has a "Total Count" of 100. (3) A gift basket of 5 different items has a "Total Count" of 1. Example: 1;50;100
count.comments: @group=Required for the item to be visible on Walmart website

multipackQuantity.title: Multipack Quantity
multipackQuantity.description: Number, Value range: 0 to 9999 - The number of identical, individually packaged-for-sale items. If an item does not contain other items, does not contain identical items, or if the items contained within cannot be sold individually, the value for this attribute should be"1." Examples: (1) A single bottle of 50 pills has a "Multipack Quantity" of"1." (2) A package containing two identical bottles of 50 pills has a "Multipack Quantity" of 2. (3) A 6-pack of soda labelled for individual sale connected by plastic rings has a "Multipack Quantity" of"6." (4) A 6-pack of soda in a box whose cans are not marked for individual sale has a "Multipack Quantity" of"1." (5) A gift basket of 5 different items has a "Multipack Quantity" of"1." Example: 1;2;4;6
multipackQuantity.comments: @group=Required for the item to be visible on Walmart website

tireAspectRatio.title: Tire Aspect Ratio
tireAspectRatio.description: Closed List - Number describing the tire’s profile and is the ratio of sidewall height as a percentage of the nominal section width of the tire, as specified by the manufacturer. Typically used as part of the ISO tire code printed on the tire.  The higher the number, the taller the sidewall; the lower the number, the lower the sidewall. For example, 60 indicates that this tire size's sidewall height (from rim to tread) is 60% of its section width.
tireAspectRatio.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

tireDiameter.title: Tire Diameter
tireDiameter.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 99999999999999 - The size (diameter) of the wheel rim that the tire is designed to fit. Measured in inches: 17; 22 Example: 16 ;17; 22
tireDiameter.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Closed List - The size (diameter) of the wheel rim that the tire is designed to fit. Measured in inches: 17; 22

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 99999999999999 - The size (diameter) of the wheel rim that the tire is designed to fit. Measured in inches: 17; 22 Example: 16 ;17; 22

tireLoadIndex.title: Tire Load Index
tireLoadIndex.description:
Closed List - Assigned numerical value that corresponds to the maximum amount of weight a tire can safely carry as shown on Tire Load Index charts. 
Example:
The load index 76 has been assigned to a load carrying capacity of 882 pounds.
The load index 87 has been assigned to a load carrying capacity of 1201 pounds.
The load index 90 has been assigned to a load carrying capacity of 1323 pounds.
tireLoadIndex.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

tireLoadRange.title: Tire Load Range
tireLoadRange.description: Closed List - The 'Load Range' letter on a light truck tire indicates its ply rating.
tireLoadRange.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

tire_location.title: Tire Location
tire_location.description: Closed List - Describes the location of a tire mounted on a vehicle.
tire_location.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

tireSidewallStyle.title: Tire Sidewall Style
tireSidewallStyle.description: Alphanumeric, 200 characters - The visual treatment of the outside of the sidewall of a tire. Can include solid color, colored stripes, or lettering. Example: Black Lettering; Black Sidewall; Outlined White Letters; White Sidewall; Solid White Letters; Solid Red Letters
tireSidewallStyle.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

tireSpeedRating.title: Tire Speed Rating
tireSpeedRating.description: Closed List - Rating system symbol that corresponds to a tire's maximum speed capability. For example, a speed rating of L corresponds to a maximum speed of 75mph.
tireSpeedRating.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

tireTreadwearRating.title: Tire Treadwear Rating
tireTreadwearRating.description: Closed List - The numeric portion of the UTQG (Uniform Tire Quality Grade Standards) printed on the sidewall of the tire that signifies a tire's durability. The UTQG (Uniform Tire Quality Grade) system is a set of standards developed by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), which is part of the United States Department of Transportation (DOT). Higher tread wear numbers indicate that the tread of a tire should last longer. A control tire is assigned a grade of 100. Other tires are compared to the control tire. For example, a tire grade of 200 should wear twice as long as the control tire.
tireTreadwearRating.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

treadDepth.title: Tread Depth
treadDepth.description: Alphanumeric, 7 characters - Vertical measurement between the top of the tread rubber to the bottom of the tire's deepest grooves tread depth, always expressed in 32nds of an inch. Example: 10/32 in; 11/32 in
treadDepth.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Closed List - Vertical measurement between the top of the tread rubber to the bottom of the tire's deepest grooves tread depth, always expressed in 32nds of an inch.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: Alphanumeric, 7 characters - Vertical measurement between the top of the tread rubber to the bottom of the tire's deepest grooves tread depth, always expressed in 32nds of an inch. Example: 10/32 in; 11/32 in

uniformTireQualityGrade.title: Uniform Tire Quality Grade (UTQG)
uniformTireQualityGrade.description: Alphanumeric, 10 characters - The composite of three individual UTQG components of tire rating of tread wear, traction and temperature tolerance. Example format: 700 AA. These Uniform Tire Quality Grade Standards (UTQG) are administered by the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA). Website: http://www.nhtsa.gov/ Example: 300 AB; 500 AA
uniformTireQualityGrade.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

vehicleClassDesignator.title: Vehicle Class Designator
vehicleClassDesignator.description: Alphanumeric, 8 characters - The letter or letters indicating the intended use or vehicle class for the tire, as specified by the manufacturer.Typically used as part of the ISO tire code printed on the tire. For example, tires that have a designation of T (Temporary) means the tire has been designed for restricted usage for space-saver type spare wheels.  Example: P; LT; ST; C; T; European Metric
vehicleClassDesignator.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

vehicle_fitment_type.title: Vehicle Fitment Type
vehicle_fitment_type.description: Closed List - Describes If The Fitment Of The Product Is Universal or Vehicle Specific.
vehicle_fitment_type.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

warrantyText.title: Warranty Text
warrantyText.description: Alphanumeric, 20000 characters - Warranty Text (the full text of the warranty terms, including what is covered by the warranty and the duration of the warranty). NOTE: please remember to update the text of your warranty as your warranty changes. Example: This warranty covers any defects in materials or workmanship, including installation, with the exceptions of fading or discoloration caused by exposure to sunlight or chemicals. This warranty runs for five years from the date your carpet is installed. Counterpoint will either replace your carpet with new carpet of similar composition and price, or refund the full purchase price of your carpet, whichever you prefer. Contact Counterpoint at 800-867-5309.
examples: This warranty covers any defects in materials or workmanship, including installation, with the exceptions of fading or discoloration caused by exposure to sunlight or chemicals. This warranty runs for five years from the date your carpet is installed. Counterpoint will either replace your carpet with new carpet of similar composition and price, or refund the full purchase price of your carpet, whichever you prefer. Contact Counterpoint at 800-867-5309.
warrantyText.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

warrantyURL.title: Warranty URL
warrantyURL.description: URL, 2500 characters - The Warranty URL is the web location of the image, PDF, or link to the manufacturer's warranty page, showing the warranty and its terms, including the duration of the warranty. URLs must begin with http:// or https:// NOTE: Please remember to update the link and/or text of the warranty as the warranty changes. If supplying an image, provide the final destination image URL (no-redirects) that is publicly accessible (no username/password required) and ends in a proper image extension. Recommended file type: JPEG Accepted file types: JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP Maximum file size: 5 MB. Example: http://www.walmart.com/warranty_info.pdf
warrantyURL.comments: @group=Recommended to improve search and browse on Walmart website

variantGroupId.title: Variant Group ID
variantGroupId.description: Alphanumeric, 300 characters - Required if item is a variant. Make up a number and/or letter code for "Variant Group ID" and add this to all variations of the same product. Partners must ensure uniqueness of their Variant Group IDs. Example: HANESV025
variantGroupId.comments: @group=Recommended to create a variant experience on Walmart website

variantAttributeNames.title: Variant Attribute Names
variantAttributeNames.description: Closed List - The designated attribute by which an item is varying.
variantAttributeNames.comments: @group=Recommended to create a variant experience on Walmart website

items.title: Variant Attribute Names
items.description: Closed List - The designated attribute by which an item is varying.

isPrimaryVariant.title: Is Primary Variant
isPrimaryVariant.description: Closed List - Note whether item is intended as the main variant in a variant grouping. The primary variant will appear as the image when customers search and the first image displayed on the item page. This should be set as "Yes" for only one item in a group of variants.
isPrimaryVariant.comments: @group=Recommended to create a variant experience on Walmart website

swatchImages.title: Swatch Images
swatchImages.description: Enter the swatch image location in "Swatch Image URL" and its corresponding variant attribute name in "Swatch Variant Attribute". Required for products with visual variations, like color or pattern. List the swatches in the order you recommend they appear on the site.
swatchImages.comments: @group=Recommended to create a variant experience on Walmart website

items.title: Swatch Images
items.description: Enter the swatch image location in "Swatch Image URL" and its corresponding variant attribute name in "Swatch Variant Attribute". Required for products with visual variations, like color or pattern. List the swatches in the order you recommend they appear on the site.

swatchVariantAttribute.title: Swatch Variant Attribute
swatchVariantAttribute.description: Closed List - Attribute name corresponding to the swatch.

swatchImageUrl.title: Swatch Image URL
swatchImageUrl.description: URL, 2500 characters - URL of the color or pattern swatch image. This is required for products with visual variations and will be shown as a small circle on the item page. File Format: JPEG (.jpg). Recommended Pixel Dimensions: 100px x 100px. Resolution: 300 ppi. Maximum file size: 5MB. Recommended File Naming: GTIN-14 digit. Provide the final destination image URL (no-redirects) that is publicly accessible (no username/password required.) Example: http://www.walmart.com/somepath/some-image.jpg

sku.title: SKU
sku.description: Alphanumeric, 50 characters - The letters and/or numbers a partner uses to identify an item. Walmart includes this value in all communications regarding item information such as orders. Example: TRVAL28726

productIdentifiers.title: Product Identifiers
productIdentifiers.description: Specify at least one Product ID and its ID Type.

productId.title: Product ID
productId.description: Alphanumeric, 14 characters - Provide the GTIN that identifies the product's consumable (selling) unit. Expand the GTIN to 14 digits by adding preceding zeroes and check digit. A GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) is used to identify an item at any point in the Supply Chain. A GTIN refers to the data structure (not symbology) used to identify the scannable item, case, inner pack (i.e., break pack) or pallet that make up the hierarchy. Example: 00123456781011

productIdType.title: Product ID Type
productIdType.description:
Closed List - Unique numbers used to tell items apart.

UPC (Universal Product Code): 12-digit code.
EAN (European Article Number): 13-digit code.
GTIN (Global Trade Item Number): 14 digits code.
ISBN (International Standard Book Number): Code is used specifically for books (either 10 or 13 digits).

price.title: Selling Price
price.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 99999999999999 - The price a customer pays for the item. Do not use commas or currency symbols Example: 100.33

ShippingWeight.title: Shipping Weight (lbs)
ShippingWeight.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 99999999999999 - The weight  including all of its packaging materials. Example: 5

country_of_origin_substantial_transforma.title: Country of Origin - Substantial Transformation
country_of_origin_substantial_transforma.description: Closed List - The country where the item and/or its components are manufactured, produced, or grown.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Inventory details for item to be transactable on Walmart

items.title: Inventory
items.description: Inventory details for item to be transactable on Walmart

quantity.title: Inventory Quantity
quantity.description: Number, Value range: 0 to 99999999999999 - What is the inventory count? (e.g. 10)

fulfillmentCenterID.title: Fulfillment Center ID
fulfillmentCenterID.description: Alphanumeric, 100 characters - The Fulfillment Center where the SKU is physically located. If you have not defined any Fulfillment Center & operate via Default Node (Virtual) then use Virtual Node ID (which is same as your Partner ID). Example: 83746529874858434 View your fulfillment center Ids https://seller.walmart.com/settings/shipping-profile/seller-fulfillment

inventoryAvailabilityDate.title: Pre Order Available On
inventoryAvailabilityDate.description: DateOnly, What is the date (yyyy-mm-dd) that inventory quantity will be available for Preorder? Required field for setting up inventory for a Preorder item. Leave blank for non-preorder items.

stateRestrictions.title: State Restrictions
stateRestrictions.description: Group of attributes to capture information when there are restrictions (legal or supplier discretion) prohibiting an item's sale.

items.title: State Restrictions
items.description: Group of attributes to capture information when there are restrictions (legal or supplier discretion) prohibiting an item's sale.

stateRestrictionsText.title: State Restrictions Reason
stateRestrictionsText.description: Closed List - The reason an item is restricted or prohibited from being sold in one or more states or zip codes. If your item doesn't have any restrictions, select "None."

zipCodes.title: ZIP Codes
zipCodes.description: Alphanumeric, 100000 characters - The postal codes in which an item is restricted or prohibited from being sold. This may also include zip codes where you prefer not to sell the item. It's your obligation to research the all laws (Federal, State, Local) that impact your product and to indicate to Walmart the required state postal code sale restrictions. If the full state is restricted, please use the States attribute. Example: 94085, 94086, 94087, 72712, 72716

states.title: States
states.description: Closed List - The full list of states in which the item is restricted or prohibited from being sold. This may also include states where you prefer not to sell the item. It's your obligation to research all laws (Federal, State, Local) that impact your product and to indicate to Walmart the required state sale restrictions.
enum: MP - Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

electronicsIndicator.title: Product is or Contains an Electronic Component?
electronicsIndicator.description: Closed List - An item is considered electronic if it contains a circuit board or electrical wiring. This includes but is not limited to any item with a screen.

chemicalAerosolPesticide.title: Product is or Contains a Chemical, Aerosol or Pesticide?
chemicalAerosolPesticide.description: Closed List - Indicates whether the item contains a chemical, pesticide, or aerosol. 'Chemical' is defined by Walmart to include any item of merchandise that contains a powder, gel, paste or liquid that is not intended for human consumption. 'Aerosol' is defined by Walmart to include any item of merchandise that contains a compressed gas or propellant (including bag-on-valve and other pressurized designs). 'Pesticide' is defined by Walmart to include any item of merchandise which is advertised or claims to kill, repel, or prevent the growth of any living organism (e.g., anti-microbial, antibacterial, anti-fungal). Even if the product is not a chemical, your product may be considered a pesticide if it makes any claims of protection from pathogens or microorganisms that extends beyond the item itself. Examples of such claims include "antibacterial," "bactericidal," "germicidal," "germ resistant," "bacteria-resistant," "kills pathogenic bacteria".

batteryTechnologyType.title: Product is or Contains this Battery Type
batteryTechnologyType.description: Closed List - Please select the Battery Technology Type from the list provided. 'Battery or battery containing product' is defined by Walmart to include any item of merchandise that is a battery or any component of merchandise, including reusable packaging intended to stay in use with the item, containing a battery of any chemistry/ type.

fulfillmentLagTime.title: Fulfillment Lag Time
fulfillmentLagTime.description: Number, Value range: 0 to 99 - Fulfillment Lag time of 0 days is suggested to improve TwoDay Delivery eligibility and customer conversion rates. Fulfillment Lag Time determines the number of days it takes the Seller to prepare an order for shipment. The default value is 0 if no entry is provided. In order to input a value of 2 days or more, you need to be approved for a Lag Time Exemption.

shipsInOriginalPackaging.title: Ships in Original Packaging
shipsInOriginalPackaging.description: Closed List - Can this product be shipped in the original packaging without being put in an outer box? Notes: 1) This is to indicate whether it's *possible* for the item to be shipped in original box, not whether it is required. 2) This was previously known as"Ships As-Is."

MustShipAlone.title: Must ship alone?
MustShipAlone.description: Closed List - Select "Yes" if your item cannot ship with another item in the same box. If marked "Yes," the ship alone item will not be grouped for ship price calculation.

IsPreorder.title: Is Preorder
IsPreorder.description: Closed List - Indicates if this item is available for preorder. Additional information will need to be provided to properly set up the preorder including Release Date. Is Preorder = Yes is REQUIRED for setting up an item as a preorder.

releaseDate.title: Release Date
releaseDate.description: Date, Provide the date that the item will be released to the public by the manufacturer. Release Date is REQUIRED for setting up an item as a preorder.  Example: yyyy-mm-dd Example: 2016-01-20

startDate.title: Site Start Date
startDate.description: DateTime, Indicates the date and time (UTC) when the item will be published on site. For preorders, this will be the date and time when the item can be Preordered by a customer. Enter hours based on military time (24-hour window, e.g. For 8PM, it will be 20 in hours) Example: yyyy-mm-dd  hh : mm : ss

endDate.title: Site End Date
endDate.description: Date, Indicates the date when the partner's item should be removed from the site. Example: yyyy-mm-dd

externalProductIdentifier.title: External Product Identifier
externalProductIdentifier.description: Closed List - Optional. Specify External Product Identifier and its ID Type if available.

items.title: External Product Identifier
items.description: Closed List - Optional. Specify External Product Identifier and its ID Type if available.

externalProductIdType.title: External Product ID Type
externalProductIdType.description: Closed List - ASIN is the Amazon Standard Identification Number. It's a unique 10-digit sequence of letters and/or numbers.

externalProductId.title: External Product ID
externalProductId.description: Alphanumeric, 10 characters - ASIN for your item Example: B002Z36VJE

ProductIdUpdate.title: Product Id Update
ProductIdUpdate.description: Closed List - Update an Item's Product ID (eg: GTIN, UPC, ISBN, ISSN, EAN). Product ID is an important identifier in Walmart systems. Walmart merges items with the same Product ID and shows them as one item sold by multiple sellers. If you provide the wrong Product ID, your item will be merged incorrectly, which can increase your order cancellation rate, create bad customer experience, produce customers fraud complaints and result in a lower rating on your Vendor Scorecard

SkuUpdate.title: SKU Update
SkuUpdate.description: Closed List - Selecting "Yes" allows the replacement of a previously submitted SKU associated with a standardized unique identifier (i.e. GTIN, ISBN, UPC, EAN) without generating an error. If "Yes" is not selected, the system will not permit the uploading of two SKUs with the same standardized unique identifier. NOTE: You should only select "Yes" if you are deliberately replacing a SKU. Selecting "Yes" in other circumstances may lead to data loss.

msrp.title: MSRP
msrp.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 99999999 - Manufacturer's suggested retail price. This is not the price that Walmart customers will pay for your product. You can use up to 8 digits before the decimal place. Do not use commas or dollar signs. Example: 19.95

minimumSellerAllowedPrice.title: Minimum Seller Allowed Price
minimumSellerAllowedPrice.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 99999999999999 - Your offer's floor/lowest price at which you are willing to sell it for. You must set a valid minimum seller allowed price for repricer to take action. Note: The Repricer will not overwrite existing MAP price rules applied through the Price & Promotions Spec. Example: 23.99

maximumSellerAllowedPrice.title: Maximum Seller Allowed Price
maximumSellerAllowedPrice.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 99999999999999 - Your offer's ceiling/highest price at which you are willing to sell it for. You must set a valid maximum seller allowed price for repricer to take action. Example: 49.99

repricerStrategy.title: Repricer Strategy
repricerStrategy.description: Alphanumeric, 75 characters - Prepopulated list of exisiting repricer strategies name that a seller has setup. The Repricing strategy that you wish to assign to your items. Select from the drop-down or copy and paste the Strategy Name from the Repricer page in Seller Center. This field is case and space sensitive - please ensure that the name matches exactly as it appears on the Repricer page. Select "No Strategy/Delete from Repricer" to remove your items from a currently mapped strategy.

product_package_dimensions_and_weight.title: Product Package Dimensions and Weight
product_package_dimensions_and_weight.description: 999999999 characters - The collective measurements of a product’s packaging, including its height, width, and depth

product_package_dimensions_depth.title: Product Package Dimensions Depth (in)
product_package_dimensions_depth.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 999999999 - The measurement of the product package from front to back, taken with the package resting on its natural base and oriented facing forward.

product_package_weight.title: Product Package Weight (lbs)
product_package_weight.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 999999999 - The weight of the  packaged product.

product_package_dimensions_height.title: Product Package Dimensions Height (in)
product_package_dimensions_height.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 999999999 - The vertical measurement of the product package from top to bottom, with the package positioned on its natural base and facing forward.

product_package_dimensions_width.title: Product Package Dimensions Width (in)
product_package_dimensions_width.description: Decimal, Value range: 0 to 999999999 - The shortest horizontal measurement of the product package from left to right, with the package placed on its natural base and facing forward.
